name: Asaph
overview: Asaph is a male biblical figure known primarily as the father of Joah, as recorded in 2 Kings 18:18. There is no specific tribal affiliation or additional personal notes provided about him. His mention is brief, focusing on his paternal role.
namesAndTitles: The name Asaph means "gatherer" and is a proper name mentioned in 2 Kings 18:18. There is no indication that this name was given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Asaph as the father of Joah, based on the reference in 2 Kings 18:18. No other family relationships are recorded beyond this paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Asaph's significance in the biblical narrative is tied to his role as the father of Joah, who appears in the context of 2 Kings 18:18. While Asaph himself does not have an extensive narrative, his mention helps establish the lineage and identity of Joah, contributing to the historical and genealogical details within the text.
